task.question: How does a pre-frozen three-component ticket bundle compare with same-target random three-ticket bundles on OOS coverage?
task.novelty: fixed three-component bundle versus 100 independently simulated same-target three-ticket bundles; evaluate union coverage, overlap and bundle maxima across 601..1245.

spec.research_question: How does a pre-frozen three-component ticket bundle compare with same-target random three-ticket bundles on OOS coverage?
spec.training_cutoff_rule: Each cached OOS prediction for target t must have training_through_round=t-1; only pre-target frozen component tickets are used.
spec.primary_metric: mean main-number hits per target round
spec.comparator: same target-round cached B component forecasts and equal-rank B where applicable
spec.baseline: exact uniform 6/45 distribution; simulated same-target random tickets when specified
spec.multiplicity_correction: Holm step-down for registered family of contrasts; descriptive outputs labelled exploratory
spec.tie_break: lower number for score ties; source component order retained
spec.novelty_signature: fixed three-component bundle versus 100 independently simulated same-target three-ticket bundles; evaluate union coverage, overlap and bundle maxima across 601..1245.
